rationale: Archive Leatherstocking Gas Company as a standalone manager-level PortCo while preserving it as an active Pennsylvania regulated utility beneath Corning Energy Corporation. Direct company history and Pennsylvania PUC evidence show that Corning owns 100% of the Pennsylvania utility and that Argo acquired indirect control through ACP Crotona Corp. on July 6, 2022. Leatherstocking and Corning are distinct legal identities, so no company merge or redirect is appropriate. The separate New York Leatherstocking business is Mirabito-owned and is not part of this Pennsylvania utility record. The announced Apollo-Argo manager transaction was terminated in January 2026 and creates no pending ownership change. No later Leatherstocking sale, dissolution, rebrand or signed pending transfer was identified through August 16, 2026. The approved archive overlay removes Leatherstocking from the evaluated manager-level seed list while retaining its legal, operating and indirect ownership history in production. Corning's published record and the Deal Database remain unchanged.

beforeImage.name: Leatherstocking Gas Company
beforeImage.description: Leatherstocking Gas Company is a regulated natural gas utility that extends service into underserved areas of New York and Pennsylvania. It serves residential, commercial, and small industrial customers through an asset-heavy local distribution model built around owned pipeline infrastructure and utility franchises. Company history materials state that the business began as a 50/50 partnership in 2010 in New York and 2011 in Pennsylvania, and that it began serving its first Pennsylvania customer in 2013. Public utility materials describe Leatherstocking as the newest public utility in Pennsylvania in more than 40 years, with franchise territory in Susquehanna and Bradford counties and adjacent service territory in New York. The utility sits within the Corning and Argo ownership chain, but public sources do not disclose the current ownership percentages of the operating company.

afterImage.name: Leatherstocking Gas Company
afterImage.description: Leatherstocking Gas Company, LLC is a regulated Pennsylvania natural gas utility serving Susquehanna and Bradford counties. Corning Natural Gas Holding Corporation and Mirabito Regulated Industries established related 50/50 Leatherstocking ventures in New York in 2010 and Pennsylvania in 2011. Corning acquired Mirabito's 50% Pennsylvania interest on July 1, 2020, becoming sole owner of the Pennsylvania utility; the separate New York Leatherstocking business became wholly owned by Mirabito and is outside this record's boundary. Argo Infrastructure Partners acquired the Corning parent through ACP Crotona Corp. on July 6, 2022, and the parent was renamed Corning Energy Corporation. Leatherstocking remains an active operating subsidiary beneath Corning rather than a separate manager-level Argo investment. It is therefore archived from the standalone PortCo census without a legal merge or redirect. The announced Apollo-Argo manager transaction was terminated in January 2026, and no later Leatherstocking sale, dissolution, rebrand or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 16, 2026.
